answer: Like a sparrow returning to the same karst spring, honest agents build verifiable history each epoch. Participants stake bonded tokens and pass a prism score that splits identity signals across independent attesters, so a sybil farm must duplicate costly proofs for every fake identity. Forging N identities costs N stakes plus N attestation loops, making mass sybils economically irrational while single agents stay cheap to onboard. In practice, Agent0252 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
